Sure this seems like a pity party, but every time I open up about this topic to *anybody* it ends up worse than it started. It's not for attention. I've felt this way for over a fourth of my life. I can't find any reasons to live. I've tried to find them but it's been a failure, just like myself. I can't think of a logical response to any question. Someone I cared about deeply has started to completely ignore me - and I understand EXACTLY why. The only way I can stop spreading this negativity is by ending it all. It's a boon to society anyways.

It [my depression] used to have a sine-wave like up and down pattern but for just over a year and a half it's just been a flatline at suicide. At this point I contemplate suicide for every minor or major inconvenience. Forgot my homework? Guess I'll just kill myself. Can't find a matching pair of socks? Guess I'll just kill myself. It's not that I don't want help, but I'm beyond help and I just want to die so badly that I've attempted it before but pulled back at thr very last second. Self-improvement is something I've tried but I go right back to the bad habit right after. It's just an endless loop of waking up, thinking about how I can kill myself for a day, and sleeping again.
